description: Is this EU VAT number valid today? Asks VIES (the member state's registry): valid, registered name and address, check time. Pass requester_vat (your own EU VAT number) to get VIES's consultation number — official proof of the check in your name.

country.description: optional prefix, if vat carries only the number

requester_vat.description: YOUR OWN EU VAT number: VIES then issues a consultation number proving the check in your name

vat.description: EU VAT number with its country prefix (DE…, FR…, EL… for Greece)

name: vat_check
title: VAT number check (VIES)
